instance_rule: Fixed before outcomes: replicate 0, six family/scale cells spanning 20-100 tasks and 2/4/8 robots. Reserve replicate 1 at T60 and T100 in two structural families. No result-dependent sample selection.
reserved_history: Both reserved IDs have E14 descriptive state-regret records in outputs/e14_state_regret_instrument/v1/development and dataset_summary.json. Reserved only from this batch; not independent or untouched validation. No test/final/lockbox access.
selection: Mean per-instance relative makespan vs manual full pool, plus 0.10 times worst positive instance regression. Simpler deployment breaks ties within 0.0005. Complete timed solves determine survival and composition; distinct feasible behaviors are admitted without local-gain gate.
composition: Per round: complementary two-generated-member addition, replacement of one manual pair by that pair-set, and cross-phase pairing of two generated sources. At final selection test removal of up to two generated members of the best multi-member proposal. Final may be manual-only.
stop: 4 rounds or 32 real requests or 2 consecutive rounds with neither improved best composition nor new behavior that is within 5% of manual mean and improves at least one instance. One engineering repair per candidate; no automatic provider retries.
